normalization: ordered finite little-endian float64 columns; signed zero normalized before SHA256; real=(Y,Yhat), synthetic=(X,Y). No text/feature extraction.
sampling: Synthetic independent Uniform(0,1) X, frozen f(X)=X, Bernoulli conditionals. NumPy PCG64 SeedSequence([seed,case_index,17923]). Real independent with-replacement labeled/unlabeled draws from unique normalized source groups; empirical-source mean, not external truth.

source.original_source: Vaishnav et al., Nature 603,455-463 (2022), as consulted in allowed upstream examples/gene_expression.ipynb
source.license: Independent npz license not declared upstream; local benchmark use only. Resolve redistribution rights before publication.
source.raw_example_limitation: Only available scalar outcome/prediction records can be normalized; underlying promoter strings unavailable. No claim of verified underlying sequence disjointness.

split: Hash-sort normalized unique real records; first floor(unique/3) search, remainder final; duplicate groups never split. source_rows/group_offsets preserve original indices. Synthetic axes identify case, statistical seed, row; controls intentionally reuse nonlinear records.

controls.reset: one first-case first-seed replay after all primary episodes; endpoints within 1e-10
controls.constant_nonlinear: scores 0.5; require candidate label-only exact binomial interval within 1e-10
controls.permuted_nonlinear: separate deterministic permutations of labeled/unlabeled nonlinear scores; reject identity or numeric-equivalent transformations; report paired width uncertainty, no compulsory no-gain threshold

aggregation: Seven cases in stated order, equal seeds within case then 1/7 per case. Copy/reset diagnostics have zero score weight but are mandatory. Missing: coverage=0,ratio=100,utility=0,failure=1; hard integrity failure combined_score=-9.5. Score percase=mean utility-10*max(0,0.95-coverage).
scientific_limits: Scientific_validity fixed conservative 0: arbitrary candidate theoretical variance assumptions cannot be certified by RPC. Empirical validity diagnostics with simultaneous uncertainty do not prove nominal coverage. correct means operational/integrity/evidence/control completion, not narrowing or publication readiness; honest negative findings eligible. Paper/theory/novelty/rights reviewed separately.
uncertainty: Clopper-Pearson case coverage CIs with Bonferroni 7 cases and 4 methods (joint 95%); paired seed bootstrap 512 resamples, RNG seed 79231, percentile simultaneous differences at 0.05/(7*3), only for complete paired widths, otherwise null with fixed failure contributions retained.
